content.text: Napui ni a khe e tami teh,
a hring kaduem ni teh runae hoi kakawi e doeh.
A pei patetlah a kamdat teh bout a kamyai.
Tâhlip patetlah a kampuen teh, bout awm hoeh toe.
Hot patetlae dawkvah, na mit na padai teh,
lawkcengnae dawk nama koe na ceikhai han na maw.
Apinimaw kathounghoehe dawk hoi,
na thoung e a la thai han,
apinihai lat thai mahoeh.
A hninnaw hah atueng khoe hnukkhu hoi,
thapa nâyittouh maw tie hah na kut dawk ao.
A tapuet thai hoeh nahanelah khori hoi a ngang pouh.
Kut ka pâ e tami patetlah a hninnaw aloum totouh,
a kâhat thai nahanelah ahni teh kamlang takhai haw.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, thing teh tâtueng nakunghai
bout a bawt hane letlang hngaihawinae ao rah.
A cakang bout a bawt han.
Talai dawk a khawngyang kahmawn nakunghai
kadout nakunghai.
Tui kahû dawk bout bawt vaiteh,
ung e patetlah a cakang a tâco han doeh.
Hateiteh, tami teh a due hoi pakawp teh a kahma toe,
tami teh a kâha a baw teh namaw ao.
Talî dawk e tui a kahma teh,
tuipui hai a hak teh be a ke.
Hot patetlah tami hai a yan teh thaw hoeh toe.
Kalvannaw ao hoeh totouh hai kâhlaw hoe toe.
Hoeh pawiteh, muet a inae koehoi kâhlaw mahoeh toe.
Oe phuen koe na hrawk sak haw,
na lungkhueknae a roum hoeh roukrak
na hrawk haw, atueng hah na pouk pouh nateh,
na pahnim hanh.
Ka kâthungnae atueng a pha totouh,
tami dout pawiteh, bout a hring han namaw
Ka ru e ka thawnaw dawk hoi ka ring han.
Na kaw vaiteh, na pato han.
Nama ni na kut hoi na sak e teh na pahren han.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ka khokhnuknaw pueng be na touk.
Hateiteh, ka yonnae naw hah na khen pouh hanh.
Kâtapoenae hah, yawngya thung khakkin e naw lah ao teh,
ka payonpakai e hah na ramuk.
Hateiteh, mon katim e patetlah,
talung teh a onae hmuen koehoi puen e patetlah,
tui ni talung pekpacin e patetlah,
tuikalen ni talai kahawi a ceikhai e patetlah,
tami e ngaihawi e hah na raphoe.
Ama teh poe na tâ teh, be a kahma awh.
A mei na kâthungsak teh, alouklah na cei sak.
A capanaw a tawmrasang e hah panuek awh hoeh.
Ahnimouh pabo lah o awh e hai kâhmawt thai hoeh.
Hateiteh, a takthai hah patawnae dawk ao vaiteh,
a hringnae ni ama a khui han telah a ti.
